actions.name: process_queue_dml_batch
actions.description:
Apply many Salesforce DML queue items using the Composite sObject
Collections API. Items are grouped by operation and endpoint and sent in
chunks of up to 200 records, Salesforce's composite collection limit.

Accepts items as `queue_items`, `items`, or `payload`. Each item has the
same shape as salesforce.process_queue_dml_item:
  {
    "operation": "create" | "update" | "upsert" | "delete",
    "sobject": "Account",
    "record": { "Name": "Acme" },
    "id": "001...",
    "external_id_field": "External_Id__c",
    "external_id_value": "acme-1"
  }

Results are returned in the same order as the input items even though the
action may issue multiple grouped Composite API calls.

actions.name: process_queue_dml_item
actions.description:
Apply one Salesforce DML operation described by an Attune queue item.
The queue item may be supplied as `queue_item`, `item`, or `payload`.

Queue item shape:
  {
    "operation": "create" | "update" | "upsert" | "delete",
    "sobject": "Account",
    "record": { "Name": "Acme" },
    "id": "001..." ,
    "external_id_field": "External_Id__c",
    "external_id_value": "acme-1"
  }

`fields` is accepted as an alias for `record`. `sobject` may be omitted
when `record.attributes.type` is present. For upsert, the external id value
may be supplied directly or present in the record under `external_id_field`.

actions.name: query
actions.description: Execute a SOQL query against Salesforce and return matching records. Supports Query All (includes deleted/archived rows) and pagination via nextRecordsUrl.

actions.name: save_list
actions.description:
Create and/or update many records in one call via the Composite sObject
Collections API (wraps sf-toolkit). Items without an Id are inserted;
items with an Id are updated. Pass `external_id_field` to switch to
upsert semantics.

Records may be **heterogeneous** — i.e. a single batch can contain
multiple sObject types — as long as each record carries
`attributes.type`. This makes the action a natural dispatch target for
a work queue that intakes raw SObject records and calls this action in
batches of up to 200 (the Salesforce composite-collection cap).

- If `sobject` is provided, it is used as the default `attributes.type`
  for any record that doesn't already declare one.
- If `sobject` is omitted, every record MUST already have
  `attributes.type` set.
- For upsert (`external_id_field` set), the Salesforce endpoint is
  per-sObject-type; records with mixed types are grouped and dispatched
  per group. For predictable behavior, prefer queue-side grouping by
  `record.attributes.type` before calling.
